test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 10 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the bracketed idiom in the given sentence.

After repeated failures and disappointments he was tempted (to throw up the sponge), but continued perseverance finally brought success.

options.text: To surrender or give up the contest

solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 2: To surrender or give up the contest.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The idiom **'to throw up the sponge'** means to admit defeat or surrender (हार मानना). 
 
• Thus, the most relevant choice is 'Option 2
